Lemma
[Pointed epsilon-isometries] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0417 ↗ def:chow-iii-g14-pointed-gh ↗ lem:chow-iii-g12-epsilon-isometry 1. appG:G.15\group Gromov–Hausdorff convergence

If $\GHpt ((X,x_0),(Y,y_0))<\epsilon $, there are $2\epsilon $-isometries $B_X(x_0,\epsilon ^{-1})\to B_Y(y_0,\epsilon ^{-1}+\epsilon )$ and conversely, both preserving basepoints.
